title: The landing demo drives the real app components from a landing-only store
decision: The walkthrough, hero rally list and stats render the app's real components (GamePanel, EntryRow, Points), not screenshots or replicas. The data comes from a landing-only Redux store and a private, paused SWR cache, with a stub pending-writes queue. Frames are inert and read-only, and make no network request. Finger-dot targets are measured on hidden mirror panels with their own stores, never by fast-forwarding the visible store.

alternatives.reason: Drift from the product and cannot animate.
Duplicate UI that drifts from the app.

consequences: App component changes show on the landing automatically.
Demo fixtures must stay valid against the app store's shape.
